rules.statement: RTL shall be synthesizable SystemVerilog following VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2 using logic declarations, with no package, plain always, always_latch, define/undef, or signed types.
RTL shall use always_comb and always_ff with process prefixes p_com_ and p_ff_ respectively, and document each logic section with comments.
Active-low reset names shall use prefix i_rst_n_ followed by the clock-domain name.
Parameters use uppercase PARA_ names, localparams use uppercase LPARA_ names, and enum type names end in _type_def.
m_ahb2axi_top is the single structural top with fixed AHB/AXI ports and instantiates only u_ahb2axi_ctrl.
m_ahb2axi_ctrl instantiates one m_ahb2axi_ahb_if (u_ahb2axi_ahb_if) and one m_ahb2axi_axi_if (u_ahb2axi_axi_if) plus its control RTL.
m_ahb2axi_ctrl instantiates five m_vlsit_sfifo_top FIFOs named u_vlsit_sfifo_top_0 through _4, with indexes starting at zero.
Both clock pins of each FIFO instance tie to i_clk_core and both hardware-reset pins tie to i_rst_n_core.
Each module is stored in a file with the same basename as the module.
The synthesis flow shall use sole top m_ahb2axi_top, legal parameter overrides, library, a single i_clk_core constraint, reset treatment and memory mapping.
The five synchronous FIFO storage arrays may map to registers or approved single-clock memory macros.
The FIFO storage implementation must meet the FIFO contract.
The design must have no latches, inferred tri-states, or technology cells outside dedicated wrappers.
